title: Multi-century psychoenergetics terrain scan started
summary: A source-dense extension to the remote-viewing module is mapping the full U.S. programme lineage, foreign assessments, SRI and Monroe records, adjacent programmes, historical analogues, disputed claims, bulk-acquisition nodes, and unresolved evidence gaps.
intent: Produce the requested source-vector index and master terrain report under the existing remote-viewing Research module, while separating official records, peer-reviewed findings, practitioner theory, historical analogy, and unsupported modern extrapolation.
reasoning: The existing remote-viewing draft pull request already owns method, practice, initial evidence balance, and integrity tooling; this lane extends it rather than rewriting its completed Event or creating a duplicate repository.

The requested siso-stargate-library repository does not exist as a separate accessible repository, while the Great Library already contains the canonical remote-viewing module and a declassified-government-records department.

The user-provided research prompt contains both documentable targets and claims that require correction or explicit uncertainty, including direct MKULTRA lineage, ancient Egyptian acoustic levitation, a Hall of Records, Delphi brainwave engineering, and later UAP programme continuity.

The Great Library is a registry and reading surface rather than an uncontrolled payload warehouse, so raw records will be represented by acquisition manifests, exact locators, custody, rights, and verification state rather than bulk-copied PDFs.
A dependent branch and pull request preserve the completed first module and make this larger scan reviewable on its own.

changes.summary: Reserved a dependent data-and-report extension beneath the existing remote-viewing module.

evidence.summary: Shaan supplied an executable research specification covering U.S. and Soviet programme lineage, SRI, CRV, Monroe/Gateway, historical and religious analogues, source indexing, and a master terrain assessment.
The existing 17-file Remote Viewing Research and Practice module was inspected; this branch starts from its exact head and reserves only a new data subtree plus append-only Event records.
The 1993 DIA STAR GATE overview, 1995 AIR evaluation, 1983 Gateway assessment, INSCOM/DIA transfer records, and mixed operational session files were checked before defining the extension.

next_actions: Build a machine-readable source index with document IDs, URLs, custody, evidence tier, claim status, acquisition state, and known gaps.

Author a master report covering programme lineage, key evaluations, SRI and CRV protocols, Monroe, foreign and adjacent programmes, historical analogues, scientific explanations, claim audit, and corpus-acquisition design.
Validate JSON, Markdown references, duplicate identifiers, and public-safety boundaries; publish a completion Event and open a dependent draft pull request against the existing remote-viewing branch.
